## FA-014 / ZEUS-f5a496e41ac2 revision 1 — Refs #15

### Defect (upstream, agreed in cross-review; root review requested changes)
The usecase template and lint accept one-line Given/When/Then while testgen requires newline syntax; generated pytest is an `xfail(strict=False)` + `NotImplementedError` skeleton with no behavior oracle; acceptance-criterion attribution, 120-character truncation, string escaping and regeneration overwrite boundaries are unbounded. The root review added that partial human acceptance must never become "all passed" by issue counts. Consensus: a common structured scenario model, stable IDs/spec revision, human oracles and real-environment receipts kept separate and linked.

### Zeus
Structured specs (GWT as statement lists, stable/retired IDs, spec hash), replay drafts only from explicit selector/oracle bindings (every oracle needs an assertion), `repr()` for embedded values, `.py.review` drafts that are never overwritten with different content, and `acceptance_passed=False` in every report already exist. The gap was **attribution**: a generated assertion could not say which scenario/oracle/requirement it exercised at runtime.
- `adapters/sdd.replay_source`: module constants `SPEC_HASH` and `ORACLES = {scenario_id: {requirement_ids, oracles}}`; every `assert_*` binding is wrapped in `with self.subTest(scenario=…, oracle=i, requirement_ids=[…], expected=…)`; actions carry no attribution; all spec text enters as Python literals, untruncated.
- `docs/contracts.md` (`INV-SDD-001`), `docs/zeus/implementation/spec-replay-attribution-001/README.md`.

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| `test_replay_attributes_every_assertion_to_its_oracle_and_requirements_at_runtime`: hostile oracle texts (triple quotes, backslashes, newlines, tabs, quotes) and a 404-char statement → `ast.parse`, constants and every `subTest`/`exact_text` literal recovered with `ast.literal_eval` equal the source text; no `xfail`/`skip(`/`NotImplementedError`; actions outside attribution blocks | pass |
| `test_gwt_must_be_lists_never_one_line_strings` | pass |
| `test_replay_export_is_idempotent_and_never_overwrites_a_different_draft` (+ `.py.review` enforced) | pass |
| Negative control: revert `adapters/sdd.py` to `origin/main` | attribution test fails |
| `tests/test_sdd.py` + `test_architecture.py` | 15 passed, 6 PG cases skipped |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14) / `ruff check` | 920 passed, 305 skipped / clean |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
Drafts remain unexecuted code not linked to device receipts or human acceptance; recording their results as FA-013 statement verdicts (`runner_receipt`) is follow-up. Multi-scenario replay, web/WebView contexts and financial flows stay blocked at generation. Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.
